"""원본 강의의 짧은 오디오로 CPU8 작업 API·SSE·자막 다운로드를 확인한다."""
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from time import monotonic
import httpx
sys.path.insert(0,'/Users/macbookair/Desktop/K-aption_BE')
from scripts.benchmark_cpu import run_media,pipeline_succeeded
from scripts.evaluate_cpu_stt_options import save_new
from scripts.evaluate_cpu_translation_threads import server_state
media=Path('/private/tmp/kaption-operator-subtitle-smoke-261025.m4a')
out=Path('/private/tmp/kaption-operator-api-261025')
report={'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'media_sha256':hashlib.sha256(media.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source_video':'MIT8_01F16_W06PS01-2_360p.mp4','clip_command':'ffmpeg -i <source> -t 25.96 -vn -c:a copy <new.m4a>','server':server_state(),'limits':['Short derived audio smoke, not whole-video SSE/export timing.','STT and translation models are already loaded after full transcription API test.']}
assert report['server']['nano_cpus']==8_000_000_000
start=monotonic()
try:
 run_media('http://127.0.0.1:8000',media,180,report)
 report['client_total_seconds']=monotonic()-start
 report['pipeline_succeeded']=pipeline_succeeded(report)
 with httpx.Client(trust_env=False,timeout=10) as client:
  for fmt in ('srt','vtt'):
   response=client.get(f"http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/jobs/{report['job_id']}/subtitles",params={'format':fmt,'language':'both'})
   response.raise_for_status()
   (out/f'job-smoke.{fmt}').write_bytes(response.content)
 assert report['pipeline_succeeded']
finally:
 save_new(out/'job-smoke.json',report)
print(json.dumps({'seconds':report['client_total_seconds'],'pipeline_succeeded':report['pipeline_succeeded'],'segments':len(report['result']['segments'])}),flush=True)

segments.text: So we have to do, we have to apply a technique called separation variables and then we want to integrate.
